facts.fact: Alyaoum24, relayed by TelQuel, reports the digital transition ministry is working on a first national open-source language model and is developing a speech-recognition model jointly with Mistral, to be released as open source, with a programme due to launch in 2027.
facts.system: national open-source language model; speech-recognition model with Mistral
